_doc: The fleet gate (speakerguardd-gate): policy only, no hardware. speakerguardd v2 runs on a board only if the protection unit its own tuning names is in units_at_parity and, while require_qualified_board is true, the board is in that unit's qualified list (a passing audible run on the shipped tree). The fleet cutover (option A) adds lsm2 and atsp to units_at_parity once they reach parity and sets require_qualified_board to false: every board with a parity unit. The kernel decides the rest: v2 runs only on a kernel with the Speaker Protection interface, the older daemons only on one without it. Every distribution ships this file unchanged.
